trap.label: it + be + that
trap.wrong: It is clear what wages lag.
trap.right: It is clear that wages lag.
trap.why: Em português “é claro que”; o brasileiro troca por what ou omite o sujeito it. Em inglês: It + be + adjetivo + that-clause.

mcq.q: **___** is obvious that prices are rising.

opts: It is clear that it works.

fix.right: It is important that we check.

fix.wrong: It is odd what he left.
fix.right: It is odd that he left.

fix.wrong: It is clear that wages is low.
fix.right: It is clear that wages are low.

rewrite.answer: It is clear that wages lag.
It is surprising that she left.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa: “It is essential that we act.” (not essential)
rewrite.answer: It is not essential that we act.
